summary: An answer as it arrives: each new word fades and sharpens in, with a caret while it streams and a waiting line before the first word.

props.name: text
props.description: The text so far. Each new word fades in as the text grows.

props.name: streaming
props.description: Still arriving: draws a caret after the last word, or the waiting line before the first.

props.name: pending
props.description: What shows before the first word arrives.

props.name: animated
props.description: The words' fade. Turn it off for text that appears at once, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.text: I found 214 photos from 2 to 16 August and sorted them into Lisbon, Porto and Sintra. Lisbon has the most, 96, mostly from the first week.
